stories.title: Validate Bilingual Learning Outcome Semantic Equivalence Using NLP
stories.description: Use sentence-transformers to validate that Bahasa Malaysia translations of learning outcomes maintain semantic equivalence with English originals. Flag translation pairs with similarity <0.85 for manual review. Generate JSON report per CoCu file showing problematic translations with line numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_bilingual_outcomes.py accepts --input content/IT-020-{3,4,5} and outputs JSON with {cocu_file, outcome_english, outcome_ms, similarity_score, line_number}
CLI exits 0 when all similarities >= 0.85, exit 1 when any pair <0.85
Report identifies exact learning outcome text from markdown with location info for correction

stories.title: Audit Hardware/Software References Against 2025 Vendor End-of-Life Database
stories.description: Scan all 20 CoCu files for hardware/software model numbers and versions. Cross-reference against vendor EOL databases (NVIDIA, Cisco, Microsoft, Intel 2025 schedules). Flag equipment within 18 months of EOL. Output CSV with equipment name, current reference in CoCu, EOL date, replacement recommendation, affected CoCu files.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/audit_equipment_eol.py reads content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md and scans for version strings (e.g., 'NVIDIA RTX 4090', 'Windows Server 2019')
Cross-reference against hardcoded EOL database (at least 50 common IT equipment entries) or SQLite database scripts/equipment_eol.db
Output CSV: equipment_name, current_version, eol_date, months_remaining, replacement_model, affected_files

stories.title: Generate Instructor Facilitation Guides with Timing Budgets and Misconception Notes
stories.description: Create markdown facilitation guides per CoCu with: detailed lab setup time, common student misconceptions, evidence-based remediation strategies, discussion prompts, timing breakdown (lecture:demo:practice:assessment), and instructor prep checklist. Generate one guide per CoCu file.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_facilitation_guides.py reads each CoCu markdown and generates output/IT-020-{level}/facilitation_guides/{cocu_number}.md
Each guide includes: Setup Time (min), Lab Sequence with timings, 3-5 Common Misconceptions with fix strategies, 2-3 Discussion Prompts, 5-item Prep Checklist
Timing breakdown sums to match CoCu's total contact hours for that activity

stories.title: Create Contact Hour Micro-Activity Scheduler with Bloom's Progression
stories.description: Break down each CoCu's contact hours into 15-minute micro-activities. Assign Bloom's taxonomy level (Remember→Understand→Apply→Analyze→Evaluate→Create) to each activity ensuring scaffolded progression. Generate Excel timeline per CoCu with columns: Time Block, Activity, Bloom Level, Duration (min), Resources, Assessment Point.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/schedule_micro_activities.py reads contact hour distribution from each CoCu and generates output/IT-020-{level}/schedules/{cocu_number}.xlsx
Each micro-activity is 15 min blocks; Bloom's levels progress within activities (no jumping from Remember to Evaluate)
Excel includes: Start Time, End Time, Activity Description, Bloom Level, Resource Links, Assessment Type columns

stories.title: Build JPK Submission Package with Compliance Manifest
stories.description: Create automated script that packages all 20 CoCu .docx files, compliance checklist, README, metadata JSON, and versioning info into a single .zip ready for JPK/MySPIKE upload. Include manifest JSON with file checksums, NOSS compliance status per file, last modified date, contact hour totals.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/build_jpk_package.py generates output/NOSS-IT-020-JPK-Package-{YYYYMMDD}.zip

Zip contains: all three .docx files from output/, compliance_checklist.json, MANIFEST.json with {files[], contact_hours_total, bilingual_count, assessment_criteria_count, noss_validation_status}, README.txt
MANIFEST.json includes per-CoCu validation: file_name, sha256_hash, contact_hours, learning_outcomes_count, assessment_items_count

stories.title: Identify and Consolidate Bilingual Terminology Variants Across All CoCu Files
stories.description: Scan all 20 CoCu files to find terminology variants (same technical concept expressed with different English or Bahasa Malaysia terms). Generate CSV showing all variations and recommend canonical term. Example: 'RAM' vs 'memory module' vs 'Random Access Memory' vs 'Modul Memori'. Provide consolidation script to auto-fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/check_terminology_consistency.py scans content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md for variant terms in key_terms sections and learning outcomes
Output CSV: term_english, term_ms_variants[], file_locations[], frequency_count, suggested_canonical_form
Auto-fix script provided: scripts/consolidate_terminology.py --dry-run and --apply modes

stories.title: Classify All Learning Outcomes by Bloom's Taxonomy Level Using NLP
stories.description: Analyze all learning outcomes across 20 CoCu files. Use NLP (action verb extraction) to classify each outcome into Bloom's taxonomy level (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create). Generate JSON report showing: outcome text, predicted level, confidence score, actual level (for manual review). Alert if <15% are at Create/Evaluate levels (indicating shallow learning).
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/analyze_bloom_taxonomy.py reads learning outcomes from all CoCu files and outputs JSON: {cocu_file, learning_outcomes[], {text, predicted_level, confidence, line_number}}
Output includes summary: {remember_count, understand_count, apply_count, analyze_count, evaluate_count, create_count, pct_higher_order_thinking}
Alert when create+evaluate < 15% of total outcomes per CoCu

stories.title: Generate Bilingual Assessment Item Bank with Semantic Equivalence Validation
stories.description: Create 40-50 assessment items (multiple choice, short answer, problem-solving) per CoCu covering all learning outcomes at multiple Bloom's levels. Provide both English and Bahasa Malaysia versions with semantic validation. Generate Quizlet-compatible CSV and DOCX study guide. Ensure 30% knowledge-level items and 70% performance-level items.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_assessment_items.py creates output/IT-020-{level}/assessment_items_{cocu_number}.csv with columns: item_id, learning_outcome, bloom_level, question_english, question_ms, answer_key, difficulty, k_or_p_classification
Semantic similarity check: all English-MS pairs must have similarity >= 0.82; output report of problematic pairs
Total items per CoCu: {30% Knowledge-level, 70% Performance-level}; validated with scripts/validate_kp_allocation.py

stories.title: Validate Vertical Competency Progression (L3→L4→L5) Without Orphaned Prerequisites
stories.description: Analyze all 20 CoCu files to ensure L4 learning outcomes logically build on L3 foundations and L5 builds on both L3+L4. Create dependency graph (DAG) showing prerequisite chains. Flag orphaned outcomes (no L3 foundation) and redundant outcomes (repeated across levels). Generate graph visualization showing competency progression and completion report.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_vertical_coherence.py reads all CoCu learning outcomes and creates dependency DAG: {l3_outcomes[], l4_prerequisites[], l4_outcomes[], l5_prerequisites[], l5_outcomes[]}
Output JSON report: {l4_orphaned_outcomes[], l5_orphaned_outcomes[], l3_to_l4_mapping, l4_to_l5_mapping, dag_valid: bool}
Generate HTML visualization (D3.js optional) showing outcome chains L3→L4→L5 with missing link detection

stories.title: Map Learning Outcomes to Malaysian IT Job Market (ISCO-08 + Real Job Postings)
stories.description: Map all learning outcomes across 20 CoCu files to ISCO-08 job classifications (IT architects, systems analysts, network admins, IT support, etc.) and cross-reference against real Malaysian IT job postings (LinkedIn, Indeed, local portals 2024-2025). Generate report showing: outcome → job roles → market demand → salary range. Flag low-market-demand competencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/map_job_market_alignment.py reads learning outcomes and generates JSON: {learning_outcome, isco08_jobs[], job_postings_found, market_demand_score, salary_range_myr, cocu_file}
Data source: hardcoded ISCO-08 mappings (at least 50 common IT roles) + sample job posting metadata (50+ entries) or external API call
Report highlights: high-demand skills (>100 postings), low-demand skills (<10 postings), salary premium skills
